questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to go to Germany and University of Heidelberg had some interesting research groups.

Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was okay, information for courses registration or general what courses are available was super difficult to find

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Introduction for general living advice by the eramus coordinator from host university

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was super confusing with the housing, since Heidelberg university first said they may be able to provide and then a week later they stated that it was not possible from their site. And on the following week, which is about 2 weeks before my arrival, it was possible to get accommodation. But it was cheap.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is not super easy to find something in Heidelberg but there is a lot of sublet from here and there, do not stress too much, once you are in Heidelberg, finding housing will be easier

questions.answer: They have their own mobility online where you upload everything

questions.answer: email to your coordinator

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was my first semester as a master student and everyone can be different semester. The level is high, but manageable and the professors are very passionate about their research which was amazing

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I only had German course and seminar(journal club presentation style)

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
German course 
CRISPR: From the lab to the clinics
Journal Club Infection, Inflammation and Cancer
Epigenetics
Glyco-Sciences

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
CRISPR: From the lab to the clinics
- The professor was really great, the paper provided was very interesting since it is applied CRISPR in mouse and human, but of course some method paper as well. So it is not just CRISPR but also can be base editing, prime editing and how clinical trial is done in a good depth. 

Glyco-Sciences
Again really great professor, here you learn how to do a PhD proposal/project proposal, which you normally don't get a chance to learn, but it is indeed challenging

questions.answer: Very similar to Denmark but Cash only and a bit old days

Learn German
Be social
Go travel
